text: The manual says the hazard lights keep working for 30 minutes, unless you switch them off manually. The hazard flasher cannot be switched on when the ignition is off. Watch out: Hazard flashing drains the battery, so do not use it for longer than necessary. The manual does not say whether turning the ignition off changes this timing.
